_comment: Feature variants of the typologies, run in addition to the plain typologies.
Each variant is laid over the listed typologies like an extra typology layer, before the
include_* flags and the HVAC mode are applied. 'set' keys are MEASURE.ARGUMENT; for the ideal
mode, add_detailed_hvac arguments go to add_ideal_loads. A value given as [[value, count], ...]
is expanded to a ';'-separated schedule (96 quarter hours per day). 'weather' replaces the EPW

variants.name: enthalpy_recovery
variants.description: Enthalpy heat recovery (DOAS heat exchanger with latent effectiveness, ideal loads Enthalpy)

variants.name: doas_coils
variants.description: DOAS heating and cooling coils with sensible heat recovery

variants.name: doas_coils_no_recovery
variants.description: Central ventilation with DOAS coils but without heat recovery

variants.name: fractional_fan
variants.description: Fractional operating schedule: reduced DOAS flow at night and on Saturday, off on Sunday

variants.name: infiltration_doe2
variants.description: DOE-2 infiltration coefficients instead of the BLAST default

variants.name: climate_2045
variants.description: Future test reference year TRY2045 Stuttgart (hotter summers)

variants.name: southern_hemisphere
variants.description: Santiago de Chile (TMYx, latitude -33.4): seasons of the DOAS SAT schedule swapped

variants.name: sizing_ddy
variants.description: Design days from the DDY file instead of automatic design days

variants.name: controls_off
variants.description: No shading control, lighting control, window ventilation or infiltration

variants.name: output_debug
variants.description: Debug output level of set_meters_idf and results
